style: One adorable ORIGINAL baby dinosaur toy as a single complete character; one dinosaur only. Full body in a consistent three-quarter side view facing left, oversized friendly expressive eyes, gentle curious smile, chunky rounded toddler-safe silhouette, soft matte pastel 3D clay-figurine illustration, subtle handcrafted surface, bright harmonious candy colors, diffuse studio lighting. Centered 1:1 square composition, entire dinosaur including tail and head visible with generous margins, plain uniform pale cream backdrop easy to remove, NO cast or ground shadow. No eggs, nest, scenery, props, costumes, text, logo, watermark, collage, multiple characters, scary teeth, sharp claws, violence, photorealism or resemblance to licensed characters.
